name: weather_current
title: Current weather
description: Get the current weather for one city: temperature, conditions and wind. Use this when the user asks about the weather now or today. For later days, use weather_forecast instead. Temperatures are in celsius unless units says otherwise.

name: weather_forecast
title: Weather forecast
description: Get a daily weather forecast for one city, starting tomorrow. Use this when the user asks about the weather on a later day or for the week ahead. Returns one entry per day with high, low and conditions, for 1 to 7 days.
